title: Prefect Flow Run Failures
dataSources: Prefect logs (`prefect:worker`, `prefect:agent`), REST API flow-run and work-pool queries (`prefect:api`).
app: Prefect worker/agent logs via Universal Forwarder; Prefect REST API (`/api/flow_runs`, `/api/work_pools`) via HEC scripted inputs; Prefect server database via Splunk DB Connect where self-hosted.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=prefect:api endpoint="flow_runs" state_type="FAILED" OR state_type="CRASHED"
| stats count as failures by flow_name, state_type
| sort - failures
description: Counts Prefect flow runs ending in FAILED or CRASHED states per flow, separating logical failures from infrastructure crashes.
value: Distinguishing crashes (infra) from failures (code/data) routes incidents to the right team and speeds resolution.
implementation: Poll the Prefect flow-runs API into HEC; schedule every 10 minutes and alert on failures/crashes for production flows.
visualization: Table of flow by state and count, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you which Prefect data jobs failed and whether it was the code or the machine, so the right person fixes it fast.
